svg.title: Where captions and equation numbers go
svg.desc: A sketch of one thesis page showing the formatting rules OGE checks most often, as the class prints them. 1: a table's caption goes above the table, in bold, with a colon after the number: Table 2.1: Values for three groups. 2: a figure's caption goes below the figure in the same style: Figure 2.1: A sample image. 3: a displayed equation, y = mx + b, has its number (2.1) in parentheses on the same line, at the right margin. 4: an equation that runs over two lines has one number, (2.2), centered vertically beside the lines. 5: the list of figures entry, 2.1 A sample image, repeats the full caption word for word, so do not write a short caption with \caption[short]{...}.
svg.text: a chapter page, as the class prints it
